description.value: Green Leaf Sushi is a Japanese sushi and Japanese cuisine restaurant in Vancouver's Collingwood neighbourhood, one of four Metro Vancouver locations operated under the same brand. The restaurant offers full indoor sit-down dining with no outdoor seating. Cyclists riding through east Vancouver have a familiar, established local chain as an option for a sit-down meal.
